messages.body: Add an option for who is under 18 and create a "choose your path" screen just for them

Done. New view 2 Sign Up/2.5 Choose a Path (Under 18): only Learn, Play and Contribute, no Teach card, with note 2.7. 1.4 Signed In has a new row, "Under 18, no path chosen yet → Choose a Path (Under 18)", that opens it. 2.4 Choose a Path lost its "13 to 17" state; its 13 to 17 row now links to 2.5, and the Hi-Fi canvas frame that showed the old state now shows 2.5.
